599:t_009:63.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is how humans ought to be.」

599:t_009:65.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$サルディアス$$...!」

599:t_010:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「His $$スフィア$$ power is stronger than ever!」

599:t_010:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You keep babbling that rubbish...! What do you know about me!?」

599:t_010:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is it. That is what I want from you.」

599:t_010:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Your hatred, which made you slaughter my men before my eyes, must never be allowed to heal.」

599:t_010:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I knew it. Behind your show of loyalty, you saw me as nothing more than a tool to wield the $$スフィア$$.」

599:t_010:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Neither of us treats people as people. That is why we can have such a good relationship.」

599:t_010:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's the spirit, $$サルディアス$$. You truly are suited to be my adjutant.」

599:t_010:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've seen me make a disgrace of myself, $c. But it won't happen again.」

599:t_010:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And you who hold the power of the civilization of fire...」

599:t_010:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You are indeed on the path to $$シンカ$$. But you cannot go any further.」

599:t_010:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You will learn what despair means! And that time will come soon!」

599:t_010:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hahaha! Until we meet again, $$セツコ$$! If you overcome despair, I'll take you on with everything I have!」

599:t_010:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「By then... my hatred will surely be able to burn everything to ashes!」

599:t_011:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The civilization of fire... $$シンカ$$...」

599:t_011:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I always thought that stuff was about $$ニュータイプ$$s and $$イノベイター$$s, and had nothing to do with me...」

599:t_011:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You are too modest... The power of 'Gun' is drawing out something in all of you besides those visibly manifested abilities.」

599:t_011:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course, whether it blossoms surely depends on what is happening over there.」

599:t_011:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What happens next is not for someone like me to say. Earthlings must see it with their own eyes and decide for themselves what to do.」

599:t_011:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now... will you advance to the place that I and the peoples of so many worlds could never reach...?」

599:t_012:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That old bastard! He talks like he's helping, then leaves us reinforcements as a parting gift!?」

599:t_012:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「He's a slippery bastard through and through!」

599:t_012:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But we have reasons we cannot retreat.」

599:t_012:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If, as $$サルディアス$$ says, our world enters its next stage when $$ラプラスの箱$$ is opened...」

599:t_012:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to see that with my own eyes.」

599:t_012:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I feel the same way.」

599:t_012:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「If our $$ガンバスター$$ has the power to guide the future, I want to see what lies beyond, too.」

599:t_012:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! I think that's why we came to this world.」

599:t_012:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「We're waiting for you to open the Box, $$バナージ$$.」

599:t_012:11.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll handle those guys until then!」

599:t_013:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! We're receiving images from $$メガラニカ$$!」

599:t_013:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is this... what's happening inside it!?」

599:t_013:2.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain! Ensign $$リディ$$ has responded!」

599:t_013:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Put him through to me!」

599:t_013:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, can you hear me!? This is $$オットー$$!」

599:t_013:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Come back! You're still a member of the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ crew!」

599:t_014:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「You did come here after all.」

599:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「There was nothing I could do... No, that's wrong... There were so many other paths, and yet...」

599:t_014:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain... Why has the Federation been so afraid of $$ジオン$$, so determined to deny it...?」

599:t_014:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「A band of demons that dropped a colony... That was the result, not the beginning.」

599:t_014:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The issue is $$ニュータイプ$$s.」

599:t_014:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Should the emergence of a new human species adapted to space be recognized in the future, those people shall be given priority in participating in government...」

599:t_014:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「The prayer spoken at the birth of the $$宇宙世紀$$... became a curse the moment $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ proposed his $$ニュータイプ$$ theory.」

599:t_014:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「As if to atone for discarding an overgrown population in space, the first prime minister, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, added a passage about the future to the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter monument.」

599:t_014:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「But he was sacrificed to the Federation's system of rule... The $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter was rewritten, and that should have been the end of it...」

599:t_014:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「If one of the terrorists behind the assassination... the $$ラプラス事件$$... $$サイアム・ビスト$$, had not obtained the real monument, it would have...」

599:t_015:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...A promise that $$ニュータイプ$$s would participate in the $$連邦政府$$... That's the true nature of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

599:t_015:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it is just as $$フロンタル$$ suspected.」

599:t_015:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$ was a clever man. He threatened the government with the monument's existence, but never made unreasonable demands.」

599:t_015:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「He helped the then-emerging $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ grow, and built the $$ビスト財団$$...」

599:t_015:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「And a symbiotic relationship with the Federation began...」

599:t_015:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「A system maintained by keeping the original monument... $$ラプラスの箱$$... hidden and revered...」

599:t_015:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「Its contents no longer matter. So the Box symbolizes the world's order.」

599:t_015:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「At first, it was at most a scandal that threatened the government of the day.」

599:t_015:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「But the rise of the $$ジオン公国$$ changed everything.」

599:t_015:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether $$ニュータイプ$$s really exist doesn't matter. The fact that the Federation buried that article is the greatest weapon for $$ジオン$$'s believers.」

599:t_015:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why the Box's existence had to remain secret, to keep this world from becoming hell.」

599:t_015:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But hell came anyway: the hell called the $$一年戦争$$.」

599:t_015:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「The enormity of its casualties, and the war's proof that $$ニュータイプ$$s existed, made the Box's curse even heavier.」

599:t_015:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's why my father and the others... why $$クロノ$$, which would not tolerate $$スペースノイド$$s, had to keep the secret.」

599:t_015:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「To deny them hope... a future... they chose to maintain a distorted system and tame the people into submission.」

599:t_015:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But you recognized that mistake.」

599:t_015:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「...I was afraid... I thought that however hard we struggled, we couldn't change the future... our fate...」
